notes.title: Halloween Updates
notes.content: New Halloween levels. Updates and Bug fixes.

notes.title: Special Halloween Levels
notes.content: Its Halloween time again, The NicoNotes are all dressed up in their finest costumes and ready to collect candy. Can you help them collect the candy and make your way to the Halloween Party in the Castle. There are dangers and puzzle to solve along the way.

notes.title: Summer Sale 2021 Discount!
notes.content:
It's Summer time again! The NicoNotes want to get out and play, and so can you. Help them find their summer nests, so they can cool down. Watch out for dangerous Xylogators! and Musical Bats!. Solve the puzzles in this action level game. Enjoy the 100's of levels in different musical environments. 
The NicoNotes Whoo are on sale for the summer sale event!

notes.title: NicoNotes Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.content:
Enjoy the Year of the Ox, The Ox is Yang in the yin and yang. (阴阳 / yīn yáng). The Ox is honest, hard working and positive, just like the NicoNotes! This year the element is Metal, so we have a Metal Gold Ox!
The NicoNotes have a ying and a yang in their design and sometimes they are ying and sometimes yang, but most of the time they are balanced. Relax and play with the cute musical NicoNotes.

notes.title: Winter Sale Time!
notes.content: Its that time of the year again. The winter sale event has arrived and the NicoNotes - The Whoo are on sale for all to enjoy.

notes.title: Halloween Update Event!
notes.content:
The NicoNotes Whoo have been busy getting ready for Halloween, play along with them in these special Halloween theme levels. New update for the game. Collect candy, change costumes, join the Monster Party!
11 new Halloween theme levels.

1 – Candy Road
2 - Ghost Town
3 – Monster Party
4 – Pumpkin Patch
5 – Sticky Swamp
6 – Cemetery
7 – Escape
8 - Crystal Caves
9 – Mad Scientist Lab
10 – Castle Friends
11 – Halloween Party

notes.title: Halloween Special Event DLC!
notes.content:
Enjoy a set of free new DLC level updates with a fun exciting Halloween Theme, Help the NicoNotes go through the spooky areas, collect candy, party with some monsters and transform in to a vampire. Get to the castle to free captive NicoNotes, then relax in the Mega Halloween party!
11 New Halloween themed levels included for Free!

notes.title: Summer Sale Discount !
notes.content:
Hi Whistlers,
The NicoNotes are off on a musical Summer Trip! They are starting with a summer discount!
Get it now at an amazing 30% off while the NicoNotes get the magic musical bus ready to go!

They are going to visit all the Groves during this summer sale, starting with the Drum Grove, where they can bounce off of all the percussion instruments! The have so much fun bouncing off of all the things that make music to get back into their nests.  They want you to help them get back into their nests in  a specific order, they like to cuddle up with their buddies.

notes.title: Its Summer Time!
notes.content:
The NicoNotes are ready to hit the road and before they do, they are going to go on sale for the Steam Summer sale!
If you have been waiting to join in on the fun, now's the time. Next Monday there will be an update and sale!
They can't wait!

notes.title: Game Launch for NicoNotes The Whoo
notes.content:
Game Launch!
The day has come to start your journey and help put those sleepy, and sometimes a little hyper, musical NicoNotes back into their nests!

Score the most points and get on the leaderboards! Each Musical Groove has its own leaderboard.
Can you be the top player overall? Maximize your scores while solving the puzzle of how to put the notes back into their nests. Watch out for some pesky critters trying to get the NicoNote Owls!

Have fun in this relaxing casual game.

The NicoNotes Whoo are now available for PC. 

Enjoy, and thanks for supporting the cute musical NicoNotes!

notes.title: Available May 29
notes.content:
[b]Tomorrow is the big Day! [/b]
[b]May 29, 2020[/b]
You can help put the NicoNotes back into their nests while avoiding some pesky Critters trying to stop them. Explore the many musical Groves each with its own theme and challenges. Many hours of fun and musical entertainment!

notes.title: Getting Ready for the Big Show!
notes.content:
Hi All, 
We are working hard to get those little musical [b]NicoNotes [/b]ready for their first performance on Steam!. They are a little nervous. But I think they will manage with your help.
